meta.name: qwen3-asr-assistant
meta.description: 智能语音转文字助手，基于 Qwen3-ASR 模型，支持实时语音识别和智能文本改写。可以将录音转换为文字，并一键改写成邮件、笔记、社交媒体文案，支持复制、分享和录音拼接。适用于会议纪要、语音备忘、内容创作等多种场景。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将录音转为文字并改写成多种格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把录音快速转成文字并整理成文档。
copy.tagline_en: Convert recordings to text and rewrite into multiple formats
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly transcribe recordings and organize them into documents.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把录音转成文字，并改写成邮件、笔记或社交媒体文案，还能拼接多段录音、一键复制或分享。
howto.when: 当你提出“语音转文字”、“录音转文字”、“语音备忘”等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这段会议录音转成文字，再改写成笔记。
say.note: Claude 会转写并整理成结构化笔记。

say.text: 把这段语音备忘改写成正式邮件。
say.note: Claude 会转写并生成邮件格式。

say.text: 我有三段录音，帮我拼接成完整文本。
say.note: Claude 会依次转写并智能拼接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can transcribe audio recordings into text, rewrite them as emails, notes, or social media posts, concatenate multiple recordings, and copy or share the result.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request 'voice to text', 'transcribe recording', 'voice memo', or similar tasks.

say_en.text: Transcribe this meeting recording and rewrite it as notes.
say_en.note: Claude will transcribe and format as structured notes.

say_en.text: Turn this voice memo into a formal email.
say_en.note: Claude will transcribe and generate an email.

say_en.text: I have three recordings; concatenate them into one text.
say_en.note: Claude will transcribe each and join them intelligently.
